latestPosts.caption:
In my last video, I asked you to question your agent before investing.

But here’s the bigger question:

What information should you actually have before putting your money into a property?

A brochure can show you the amenities.
A presentation can show you the returns.
And an agent can tell you why the project is “the best.”

But a smart investor looks deeper.

🔹 What is the developer’s track record?
🔹 Is there genuine demand for the project?
🔹 How strong is the location “today and 5 years from 
  now?”
🔹 What is the actual deal structure?
🔹 What are the hidden costs and charges?
🔹 What is the exit strategy?
🔹 And most importantly, “does the investment actually 
  make sense?”

That’s exactly what I want to bring to this page.

Not just properties.
Knowledge. Research. Market insights. And the information you need to make an informed decision.

Because my goal isn’t to convince you to buy.

My goal is to make sure that when you do invest, you know WHY you’re investing.

Investment is yours.

But giving you the right information is my responsibility.

Welcome to the journey. 🇮🇳🤝🇦🇪

No hype. No pressure. Just the truth about Dubai Real Estate.
.
.
#dubairealestate #dubai🇦🇪 #gujarati #fyp #relatablecontent

Gujaratis have built businesses, created wealth, and invested across the world.

But when it comes to Dubai Real Estate, one question matters:

Are we investing because it’s the right investment… or because someone told us it is?

I’m Faiyaz Sachora — a son of Gujarat, born into a developer family, and today a Dubai Real Estate professional.

I didn’t come to Dubai just to sell properties to Gujaratis.

I came here to make sure my fellow Gujaratis make smarter decisions with their money.

So the next time an agent shows you a property, don’t just ask about the price, payment plan or expected returns.

Ask them:

Why this project?
Why this developer?
And most importantly, would YOU invest your own money here?

If the answers don’t give you confidence,
don’t rush your investment.

Because your money deserves more than a sales pitch.

It deserves research. Transparency. And the right advice.

This is my promise to my community:

I may not tell you what you want to hear.
I’ll tell you what you NEED to know.

From Gujarat to Dubai,
let’s build wealth the smarter way. 🇮🇳🤝🇦🇪

No hype. No pressure. Just the truth about Dubai Real Estate.

- Faiyaz Sachora
.
.
#dubairealestate #investindubai #gujarati #gujjus #fyp
